activity_statements.statement: provides consumer banking services including checking and savings accounts, mortgages, personal loans, investing, and credit cards (Citi Strata, AAdvantage co-brand) to US retail customers

provides integrated cash management and trade services through Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) to 65,000+ multinational corporate, financial institution, and public sector clients in 120+ countries
operates investment banking and capital markets services for institutional clients globally, including underwriting, M&A advisory, and securities trading
operates in 90+ countries making it one of the most globally distributed banking institutions, serving clients across the complete commerce path
issues co-branded credit cards with American Airlines (AAdvantage), Costco, and other partners for consumer and commercial cardholders
provides working capital solutions including receivables, liquidity management, and channel services to corporate treasury departments

name_reality_gap: Known as a consumer bank in the US, but the majority of Citi's business by revenue is institutional: it is one of the largest global transaction banks and investment banks, with Treasury and Trade Solutions alone serving 65,000+ institutional clients in 120+ countries.
extraction_notes: citi.com/about and online.citi.com timed out; homepage and institutional TTS pages provided usable content. Segment revenue weights are directional estimates based on publicly known Citi business mix.
